**CHILD SAFEGUARDING:**  

Level 2: the role holder will have contact with children and/or young people either frequently (e.g. once a week or more) or intensively (e.g. four days in one month or more or overnight) because they work in country programs; or are visiting country programs; or because they are responsible for implementing the police checking/vetting process staff.  



**Project Background**  

The Agri\-skills for Resilient, Inclusive and Sustainable Economies – Green Resilience and Employment Enhancement Network (ARISE\-GREEN) is a 48\-month, European Union\-funded Agri\-Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) initiative under the Skills for South Sudan’s Youth in the Agri\-Value Chain Sector Action. The project is implemented by a Save the Children (SCI)\-led consortium, Hope Africa South Sudan (HASS), and the Christian Agency for Peace and Development (CAPaD) as Co\-Applicants. ARISE\-GREEN aims to reform and strengthen inclusive, accredited, and climate\-responsive Agri\-TVET systems in South Sudan. Operating across 7 counties in Eastern Equatoria (Magwi, Torit, Kapoeta South), Central Equatoria (Juba, Terekeka), and Lakes State (Rumbek Central, Yirol East), the project targets 12 public TVET institutions, upgrading 3 into specialized Centres of Excellence. The project will directly support 5,538 vulnerable youth (including IDPs, returnees, refugees, women, persons with disabilities, and UNMISS\-referred high\-risk individuals) by shifting agricultural training from theoretical instruction to practical, market\-led Competency\-Based Training (CBT) anchored across green agri\-value chain nodes.  

**Role Purpose**  

Based in Juba, the Consortium Project Manager will provide overall strategic leadership, technical oversight, and operational management for the successful implementation of the 48\-month ARISE\-GREEN project. The role is responsible for ensuring high\-quality, fully compliant delivery across the entire consortium structure, leading coordination between lead and co\-applicants (HASS and CAPaD), and managing critical geographic and strategic interfaces with the parallel NRC\-led consortium. The incumbent will serve as the primary focal point for the European Union contracting authority, national ministries (MoGEI, MoL, MAFS), UNMISS, and private sector stakeholders. They will ensure that provider\-level improvements effectively feed into sub\-national and national system reforms.  

  



**SCOPE OF ROLE:**  

**Reports to:** Head of Programme Implementation  

  

**Staff reporting to this post: Agric TVET Coordinators, Consortium MEAL Coordinator, Consortium Finance Coordinator, Agric TVET Officers**  

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**  

**1\. Consortium Leadership \& Strategic Management**


* Provide overall guidance, leadership, and vision to the consortium partners (HASS and CAPaD) to ensure unified, qualitative, and timely project delivery.
* Manage sub\-grant agreements and ensure all consortium members adhere to Save the Children policies, European Union regulations, and national standards.
* Lead the inception phase planning, including the execution of joint TVET centers Assessment and Labour Market Assessments, value chain skills gap analyses, and priority Agri\-TVET vocations for curricula and modules development.
* Finalize and sign Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) with an estimated 49 private sector companies and value\-chain actors to host apprenticeships and work\-based learning (WBL).


**2\. Technical \& Program Operational Delivery**


* Oversee the transition from theoretical instruction to practical Competency\-Based Training (CBT) across 12 designated public TVET centers and 3 Centres of Excellence.
* Direct institutional strengthening efforts, including the roll\-out of Institutional Development Plans, Quality Assurance (QA) systems, and facility/workshop upgrades.
* Supervise the capacity building and professional development of 240 TVET instructors in inclusive, practical, and climate\-smart teaching methodologies.
* Coordinate the design and distribution of specialized self\-employment Start\-up Productivity Kits and business incubation services for graduates, ensuring alignment and avoiding duplication with parallel GRE inputs.


**3\. Partner Coordination \& Systems Alignment**


* Maintain a highly functional, complementary relationship with the NRC\-led consortium, utilizing a shared area\-by\-area matrix to ensure geographic deconfliction and harmonized beneficiary targeting.
* Operationalize and lead sub\-national multi\-stakeholder dialogue platforms and 3 state\-level TVET Ad\-hoc Committees to bridge the institutional divide between the agricultural and skills sectors.

About This Role

**Senior Digital Data Analyst**


**About the Role**


We are looking for a Senior Digital Data Analyst to help shape how we measure, understand, and improve digital performance across our web experiences. This is a senior individual contributor role for an analyst who combines technical fluency, strong business judgment, and sharp problem\-solving skills.


In this role, you will support day\-to\-day digital analytics needs across website tagging, reporting, analysis, and data\-driven personalization and experimentation. You will partner with stakeholders across digital, marketing, content, and optimization to ensure data is reliable, insights are actionable, and measurement supports better business decisions.


This role is best suited for someone who is thoughtful, curious, and highly self\-directed. We are looking for an analyst who can work through ambiguity, spot issues before they become problems, and make sound decisions without needing step\-by\-step direction. You should be comfortable asking hard questions of the data, validating your own work, and adapting your approach when the situation does not fit a familiar pattern.


**What You’ll Do**


* Support digital analytics across websites and digital experiences, including reporting, ad hoc analysis, and measurement planning.
* Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into clear measurement approaches, reporting structures, and analytical frameworks.
* Build, maintain, and improve dashboards, recurring reporting, KPI definitions, and insight\-driven analyses.

* Support evolving measurement needs tied to organic growth, content performance, and emerging AI\-driven traffic sources.

**Who You Are**


* You are a strong critical thinker who knows how to move from question to analysis to recommendation.
* You do not stop at producing a report, you look for what is meaningful, what may be wrong, and what action should follow.
* You can reason through ambiguity and make sound decisions when the answer is not obvious.
* You catch your own errors and challenge outputs that do not make sense.
* You are comfortable working independently and do not need highly prescriptive direction to make progress.
* You communicate clearly and can explain your thinking, assumptions, and conclusions with confidence.
* You value rigor, accuracy, and strong analytical judgment.

**Qualifications**


**Required**


* 5\+ years of experience in digital analytics, web analytics, marketing analytics, or a related field.


* Deep hands\-on experience with Adobe Analytics.


* Strong experience in reporting, segmentation, analysis, and digital performance measurement.


* Working knowledge of website tagging concepts, analytics QA, and data governance.


* Experience supporting experimentation, personalization, or optimization initiatives.


* Proven ability to solve problems independently and work effectively in ambiguous situations.


* Strong written and verbal communication skills.


**Preferred**


* Familiarity with SEO measurement, content performance analysis, and digital growth strategies.
* Experience in environments that are automating parts of the analytics workflow.
* Exposure to measuring and interpreting emerging traffic patterns, including AI\-driven traffic sources.
* Experience evaluating or working with analytics tagging QA tools.
* Power BI experience is preferred.

**What Success Looks Like**


In this role, success means more than delivering reports on time. It means producing work that is accurate, well\-reasoned, and useful. It means identifying issues early, asking the right questions, and helping the business make better decisions with confidence. It means bringing a high standard of analytical rigor to reporting, tagging, testing, and performance analysis, while continuing to improve how the work gets done.


**Why Join Us**


This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in how digital performance is measured and improved. You will work on a broad mix of analytics, measurement, optimization, and experimentation challenges, and you will help shape a more scalable, data\-driven approach as our capabilities continue to evolve.

The Agri\-skills for Resilient, Inclusive and Sustainable Economies – Green Resilience and Employment Enhancement Network (ARISE\-GREEN) is a 48\-month, European Union\-funded Agri\-Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) initiative under the Skills for South Sudan’s Youth in the Agri\-Value Chain Sector Action. new_jobs.description:
About This Role
**5 to 8 years of experience**  

**Skills: digital analytics, web analytics, marketing analytics, Adobe Analytics.**

**Senior Digital Data Analyst**


**About the Role**


We are looking for a Senior Digital Data Analyst to help shape how we measure, understand, and improve digital performance across our web experiences. This is a senior individual contributor role for an analyst who combines technical fluency, strong business judgment, and sharp problem\-solving skills.


In this role, you will support day\-to\-day digital analytics needs across website tagging, reporting, analysis, and data\-driven personalization and experimentation. You will partner with stakeholders across digital, marketing, content, and optimization to ensure data is reliable, insights are actionable, and measurement supports better business decisions.


This role is best suited for someone who is thoughtful, curious, and highly self\-directed. We are looking for an analyst who can work through ambiguity, spot issues before they become problems, and make sound decisions without needing step\-by\-step direction. You should be comfortable asking hard questions of the data, validating your own work, and adapting your approach when the situation does not fit a familiar pattern.


**What You’ll Do**


* Support digital analytics across websites and digital experiences, including reporting, ad hoc analysis, and measurement planning.
* Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into clear measurement approaches, reporting structures, and analytical frameworks.
* Build, maintain, and improve dashboards, recurring reporting, KPI definitions, and insight\-driven analyses.
* Create, organize, and maintain analytics documentation in SharePoint, including measurement frameworks, KPI definitions, implementation notes, reporting logic, and process guidance.
* Identify trends, performance drivers, risks, and opportunities, then turn findings into clear recommendations.
* Serve as a strong practitioner in Adobe Analytics, including segmentation, calculated metrics, attribution, workspace analysis, and data interpretation.
* Review data critically, investigate anomalies, reconcile discrepancies, and catch errors before work is shared.
* Support day\-to\-day website tagging operations by helping define requirements, reviewing requests, validating implementation, and strengthening QA and governance processes.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to ensure digital measurement is aligned with reporting, analysis, and optimization needs.
* Support personalization and experimentation efforts with audience analysis, measurement planning, test readouts, and insight generation.
* Help ensure testing and personalization decisions are grounded in a disciplined, data\-driven approach.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to automate repeatable work, improve workflows, and strengthen analytics practices.
* Support evolving measurement needs tied to organic growth, content performance, and emerging AI\-driven traffic sources.

**Who You Are**


* You are a strong critical thinker who knows how to move from question to analysis to recommendation.
* You do not stop at producing a report, you look for what is meaningful, what may be wrong, and what action should follow.
* You can reason through ambiguity and make sound decisions when the answer is not obvious.
* You catch your own errors and challenge outputs that do not make sense.
* You are comfortable working independently and do not need highly prescriptive direction to make progress.
* You communicate clearly and can explain your thinking, assumptions, and conclusions with confidence.
* You value rigor, accuracy, and strong analytical judgment.
* You understand that effective experimentation and personalization require solid methodology, reliable data, and thoughtful interpretation.

**Qualifications**


**Required**


* 5\+ years of experience in digital analytics, web analytics, marketing analytics, or a related field.


* Deep hands\-on experience with Adobe Analytics.


* Strong experience in reporting, segmentation, analysis, and digital performance measurement.


* Working knowledge of website tagging concepts, analytics QA, and data governance.


* Experience supporting experimentation, personalization, or optimization initiatives.


* Proven ability to solve problems independently and work effectively in ambiguous situations.


* Strong written and verbal communication skills.


**Preferred**


* Familiarity with SEO measurement, content performance analysis, and digital growth strategies.
* Experience in environments that are automating parts of the analytics workflow.
* Exposure to measuring and interpreting emerging traffic patterns, including AI\-driven traffic sources.
* Experience evaluating or working with analytics tagging QA tools.
* Power BI experience is preferred.

**What Success Looks Like**


In this role, success means more than delivering reports on time. It means producing work that is accurate, well\-reasoned, and useful. It means identifying issues early, asking the right questions, and helping the business make better decisions with confidence. It means bringing a high standard of analytical rigor to reporting, tagging, testing, and performance analysis, while continuing to improve how the work gets done.


**Why Join Us**


This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in how digital performance is measured and improved. You will work on a broad mix of analytics, measurement, optimization, and experimentation challenges, and you will help shape a more scalable, data\-driven approach as our capabilities continue to evolve.


Apply now
